title: Dutch Bouillabaisse Stew
description: A hearty, flavorful stew originating from the Netherlands, inspired by the classic French Bouillabaisse. Rich and comforting, it's perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Heat the Dutch Nutty Brown Ale in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced carrot and diced potato, and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the fresh mussels, canned bouillabaisse, and tomato paste.
Stir to combine, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10-15 minutes or until the mussels are cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
